answer_1.quote: we fine-tuned the open-source Llama-2 model to generate multi-level feedback ... we demonstrate that our approach generates high-quality feedback ...
answer_1.outputs: multi-level feedback annotations for peer counselor utterances

answer_2.quote: We use the automatically-computed quality scores ... Mean Score Overall ... Mean Score Worst ...

answer_3.quote: Our self-improvement method relies on the fine-tuned LLM itself to provide automated scoring feedback on candidate outputs; this forecast operation estimates the quality of the originally generated feedback ... we align M on the Preferences QESconv dataset using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

answer_4.quote: We conducted extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluation with domain experts ... Experts rated the feedback quality along eight aspects ... using a 5-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Domain experts evaluated the generated feedback using a 5-point Likert scale across multiple predefined criteria.
